items.headline: G20 Foreign Ministers Conclude Atlanta Summit Without Consensus on Key Issues
items.summary: Group of 20 foreign ministers concluded a two-day diplomatic summit in Atlanta without issuing a joint communique due to persistent disagreements over geopolitical conflicts and economic security. Hosted by U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio, the high-level talks focused on supply chain resilience and navigation rights but underscored deep global divisions.

items.headline: NASA Volunteers Exit 378-Day Simulated Mars Habitat in Houston
items.summary: Four volunteer crew members emerged from a 3D-printed facility at NASA's Johnson Space Center after spending 378 days living in simulated Martian conditions. The completion of the yearlong CHAPEA mission provides researchers with essential data on crew health, isolation stress, and resource management for future deep space exploration.

items.headline: Kimi Antonelli Becomes Youngest-Ever Formula 1 Champion at Mexico City Grand Prix
items.summary: Twenty-year-old Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli finished third at the Mexico City Grand Prix on Sunday to secure his maiden Formula 1 Drivers' Championship. By clinching the title with four races remaining, Antonelli broke Sebastian Vettel's long-standing record to become the youngest world champion in Formula 1 history.

items.headline: Wu-Tang Clan to Headline Detroit Lions Thanksgiving Halftime Show Produced by Eminem
items.summary: The Detroit Lions announced that legendary hip-hop group Wu-Tang Clan will headline the halftime show for the 87th annual Thanksgiving Day game on November 26. Executive produced by Eminem and Paul Rosenberg, the high-profile performance comes as the group wraps its global farewell tour and prepares for induction into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.
